scene sky
: Finally! The greatest part of the day!
scene mayaeats1
: The time for me to eat and not be disturbed by anyone!
What Maya Makinami did not know at this point in time is that she would be disturbed. But not before another vague monologue about things that will only kinda sorta make sense.
At least for now. But you don’t have to worry about cottontails or deer parts or eggs or flowers or any other recurring symbol this time.
Instead, you just have to worry about a little thing called “love,” which you may or may not be familiar with based on how adept you are at communicating with actual human beings.
If you’ve made it this far, I’d wager you’re not very good at all. But that’s not an attack on you or anything of the sort. It’s more of just an...observation.
You see, love is all about the “give and take.” But mostly, it’s about the take since the whole point of life is ending with more than you started off with.
But for Maya Makinami, dying (if we’re going to call it that) actually worked in her favor. And that’s the complete opposite of how it is for all of those one-lifers out there.
She wasn’t exactly happy right now, but she did have something. And that put her several steps above a bunch of miserable people out there.
That thing she had was currently eating away at her happiness, though — just as she is about to eat the over-sized lunch spread you see before you.
It’s hard to love someone who doesn’t know how to love you back. And it’s even harder when you don’t really know how to love in the first place.
So relationships like that become this sort of messy game of just throwing feelings and sex at each other until you’re both kind of just calm and unconcerned. And no that’s not a hint.
It’s just the way things are. And that’s more true than ever right now as she locks her eyes on several slices of her favorite fruit and tries to pretend she doesn’t know he’s here right now.
Truth be told, she was getting kind of aggravated at having to be the aggressor all of a sudden. But if acting in protest to the way she wants to be is what it takes to make things messy, so be it.
It wasn’t unrequited. At least that’s what she thought. And sooner or later, these weird games would all come to an end.
scene mayaeats2
But sooner or later, all things come to an end. And she was presently unaware of just how true this was.
She’s nothing more than recyclable plastic — a ring around a turtle’s neck.
She’d suck the life out of anyone she touches because she’s in a place she’s not supposed to be.
And so are you.
So why don’t you just give up already, huh?
Are you really going to throw more trash into the ocean?
scene mayaeats1
: Finally! The greatest part of the day!
: The time for me to eat and not be disturbed by-
scene mayaeats3
: Hey. Do you mind if I join you for a little bit?
scene mayaeats4
: Fuck!
: Uh...is that a no?
scene mayaeats5
: Yes.
: Oh, it’s a yes?
: No!
: So you don’t mind if I join you. Great.
scene mayaeats4
: Fuck!
scene sky
Makoto Miyamura, someone else struggling to balance love with happiness lately, takes a seat beside the stray cat and gazes at her, but not in the yuri sort of way.
She kind of just looks at her and thinks, “Fuck. She’s really pretty.” But again, not in the yuri sort of way. In the jealous sort of way.
scene mayaeats6
Makoto Miyamura knew just as well as Protag McMainguy and his jolly blonde companion that this Maya was not the Maya of old. But that didn’t make her any less threatening.
Makoto thought of drowning her in the ocean — but she wasn’t going to do that because murder was a step or two beyond what she was willing to do in an incessantly looping timeline.
So instead, she just kept staring at her like a wolf would its mate in the several seconds it would take before mounting it. But again, not in the yuri sort of way.
: What do you want, Makoto?
: Just...to talk. If that’s okay.
: Can it wait until I’m done eating?
: No. If you start eating, you’ll never stop. It’s one of the only things I actually know about you.
: Then you have certainly picked a strange person to “talk” to.
scene mayaeats7
: Yeah. I guess I have, haven’t I?
: Don’t smile at me. It makes it look like we’re having a moment.
: Would you prefer I just cut to the chase then?
: I don’t think there is anything I want more right now.
scene mayaeats8
: Then I’ll be blunt. You’re not who you think you are.
: Is this some sort of riddle? Because riddles annoy me. You annoy me. Leave.
: You should start listening to Ayane and Sensei. Your entire existence is becoming a huge burden to them.
scene mayaeats9
: Excuse me?
: I didn’t mean that as an insult. It’s just that your presence makes them absolutely miserable.
: I’m suddenly very unsure of whether or not you know what an “insult” is.
: Frankly, I kind of wish you’d just go away.
scene mayaeats10
: Jesus, Makoto! What the hell did I ever do to you?!
: Sorry. I’ve just...found myself in a rather strange predicament as of late and...that predicament is made significantly more difficult with you not remembering who you are.
scene mayaeats11
: Oh my fucking- this again? Seriously? Does the joke never end?
: Do you really think it would be a joke with me in on it too? I have nothing to do with your “love squad” as Ayane calls it.
scene mayaeats12
: Love...squad?...
: You...her...and Ami. Three friends who I have no real connection to outside of school and...I guess rooftops now.
: I mean...I guess it would be weird for you to be in on a joke like that. But it’s not like you aren’t close to Sensei. He could have just blackmailed you into this or something.
: Do you really think he’d do something like that?
: Probably. He’s a fucking creep who gets off on tormenting me. He’ll stop at nothing to make my life a living hell.
: Then why are you sleeping with him?
scene mayaeats13
: Wha- are you out of your fucking mind?! I have nothing to do with-
scene mayaeats14
: Relax...I’m not going to tell anyone. I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t a bit envious though. Sensei won’t ever look at me the way he looks at you. Or...looked at you.
: He hasn’t been doing that as much as you’d like lately, has he?
scene mayaeats15
: You’re in the manga club, aren’t you? Surely you must have read some story about...amnesia or...time loops-
: I’m in the manga club because I enjoy immersing myself in different worlds, not because I’ve fallen into one.
: But what if you have? Because you’re not just different to him. He’s different to you now...isn’t he?
: I have no idea, Makoto. Like I said...I barely know the guy.
: Well that’s not true at all.
scene mayaeats16
: God fucking- now you’re here too?! Will I ever be able to eat?
: You can eat right now. No one’s stopping you.
: Actually, I was. I’ve heard that Maya turns into a human-funnel when she eats and I wanted to talk to her before she got stuck in that state.
: Oh, okay. Never mind. Makoto’s stopping you. But still, what’s all this about you not knowing Sensei? We’ve both known him since we were little.
scene mayaeats17
: I suddenly wish I was part of a manga so Noriko could get hit by a truck and be sent to another universe.
: Wow. She really doesn’t like you, does she?
: No...she does not.
: Fine. I do know Sensei. But that doesn’t mean my relationship with him is even close to what you’re insinuating.
: May I join in? Because I kind of overheard what you guys were talking about here and I want to add that...yeah. You’ve been weird lately, Maya.
scene mayaeats18
: You’re weird every fucking day and you don’t see me complaining about it!
: Yeah I do. Almost every time I talk to you, actually.
: Then stop fucking talking to me, idiot!
: Oh, right. Sensei did say something about you noticing as well during our meeting the other day.
scene mayaeats19
: What meeting? What excuse is that creep coming up with to spend more time with teenage girls outside of school?
: I imagine you’ll find out at our slumber party tonight.
scene mayaeats20
: I would rather die.
: Hey, you’re coming too?! Wanna share a futon and talk about how weird Maya has been all night?
: Can I just put my futon next to yours instead?
: Sure, but I’d hear you a lot better if you would just whisper into my ear.
: I’ll keep that in mind if I stumble into an experimentation arc in the near future.
: What do you mean by “weird?”
scene mayaeats21
: I mean that prior to our spontaneous karaoke trip, you were an entirely different person with entirely different memories.
: Or...I guess...more memories? Ayane would know better than I do. Don’t you remember talking about this at my family’s shop?
: What? Of course not. I don’t even know where your family works.
: Makoto’s family runs the local porn shop. Don’t ask how I know. I’m a good girl.
: Did you hear something just now? Because I could have sworn I heard a garbage truck pulling up.
scene mayaeats22
: One day, the two of us will kiss. And it will be amazing.
: There it is again. I could have sworn the truck only came on weekdays.
: Maya...I’m trying to be serious right now. Things have happened that you don’t remember. Recent things. And it’s because your memories were purged for...reasons.
scene mayaeats23
: Makoto’s right. Like, when I came into class a couple months ago, it was like you forgot I was even enrolled at Kumon-mi High. There was no need to freak out on me a second time.
: That was just a momentary memory lapse. I didn’t get much sleep the night before.
: Okaaaay. But if you also don’t remember buying porn with Makoto-
: Objection. We never bought porn together.
: If you don’t remember watching porn with Makoto-
: Objection. That didn’t happen either.
: If you don’t remember acting in a hardcore porno with Makoto-
: Obj- oh, fuck it.
: Then chances are it was more than just one memory lapse. And I’m hard-pressed to believe there haven’t been a million other things that have happened without us around.
: You’ve gotta know something is up, Maya. You’re fucking brilliant. A major bitch, yeah. But you’ve always been ahead of the curve when it comes to perception.
: Like...I was talking to Sensei about it the other day but, maybe you just have the same thing he has? Maybe it’s some kind of...trauma-suppression thing? I don’t know.
scene mayaeats24
: What do you mean “what he has?” His memories are fine. He’s just...unintentionally gotten rid of the shitty ones. Which is a good thing.
: But he completely forgot who even I was, Maya.
: Like I said, he got rid of the shitty ones.
scene mayaeats25
: Okay. That one’s on me. I set you up for that.
: Do you really not remember Sensei’s constant memory lapses near the beginning of the school year? Or how...out-of-place he seemed to become out of seemingly nowhere?
: I mean...not really, no.
: Well everyone else does, Maya. And if everyone else remembers something that you don’t...surely you must believe it’s not just some “joke” anymore...right?
scene mayaeats26
: I mean...I’ve definitely noticed some things that are...different.
: But people don’t just lose memories like that for no reason. There has to be some kind of catalyst. And literally nothing has happened.
: Again...something did happen. Something that reset your memory.
scene mayaeats27
: To when? The beginning of the school year? Why? How? I still have an entire lifetime worth of memories. That’s how I know I hate Noriko.
: That’s...the part I wish I knew.
scene mayaeats28
: But what if you had more than just one lifetime worth of memories before this? What if you had hundreds or...thousands of them?
: What?...That makes literally no sense whatsoever.
: Trust me, I know. But what if that were the case? Do you think you’d still be the same person you are now?
: Uhh...no? How could anyone be the same after being subjected to that kind of torture?
: They couldn’t and they wouldn’t. And that is why I called you a burden.
scene sky
: That is what Sensei lost.
: And I think that you need to talk to him about it if you want a real chance at changing anything.
Makoto Miyamura kicked herself for this random act of kindness as the other two girls sat there at the table, attempting to contemplate what any of that meant.
She could have very well just let Maya remain lost since the only two other people with the chance of ever reminding her of who she really is were too pained to try their hardest...
But she didn’t.
And now she was going to have spend even more nights wondering who the man she loved was with when all she really wanted was to crawl inside his skin and sleep there.
scene black
Love is a game of give and take...but not everyone plays correctly.
Thankfully for Makoto, she gets more than one life.
And thankfully for Maya-
Actually-
I’m not sure she has any left.
Huh.
I guess she really is unlucky.
